name: Ricardo Benavides
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying business administration at the University of Valencia, he volunteered at a local rally event, quickly discovering a passion for the sport's high-octane environment and intricate logistics. After graduating, Ricardo leveraged his marketing knowledge to secure a role at a smaller racing team, where he honed his skills in brand management, sponsorship acquisition, and digital marketing strategies. He joined PEX Motorsport two years ago, drawn to their innovative approach and commitment to nurturing young talent.

As a marketing coordinator, Ricardo focuses on developing and executing comprehensive marketing campaigns that enhance brand visibility and drive fan engagement. His pragmatic approach ensures that every initiative is data-driven and aligned with the team's overall objectives. Ricardo is known for his ability to identify emerging trends and integrate them into PEX Motorsport's marketing strategy, keeping the team ahead of the curve. He believes in building strong relationships with sponsors and media partners, fostering mutually beneficial collaborations that amplify the team's message.

What sets Ricardo apart is his exceptional organizational skills and his unwavering dedication to achieving tangible results. He meticulously tracks campaign performance, providing detailed reports and insights to optimize future strategies. His calm demeanor and problem-solving skills make him a valuable asset to the PEX Motorsport team, ensuring that marketing efforts contribute to the team's success both on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a side part
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down marketing ideas, even during meetings.
Has a habit of organizing his desk meticulously before starting any new project.
Insists on trying new marketing software or platforms before anyone else, acting as an internal beta tester.
